corrections.target_of_correction: r10_factor_basis_delivery/COMMAND_LEDGER.json seq 1 (STAGE_AND_VERIFY_PACKAGE, started 2026-10-25T00:45:43.6495082+08:00) and the receipt sentence that package verification preceded any execution

resolution_using_retained_artifacts_only.reading: the staged copies existed at 2026-10-24T16:30:05ZZ, i.e. 22 s before the 12-control run began at 00:30:27Z. corrections.not_claimed: no exact first-run timestamp is asserted; the ledger is not reordered or rewritten, and no measurement is rerun to manufacture one
corrections.relevance_noted: the comparison driver itself re-verifies package hashes before its real preflight, so the comparison output is self-protected independently of this chronology
